solvers.summary: Computer algebra: symbolic simplification, solving, series, number theory, Groebner bases.
FLINT bindings: fast exact integers, rationals, polynomials, matrices, and ball arithmetic.
PARI/GP bindings: number fields, elliptic curves, factoring, and class groups.
Composable exact mathematics operations for agents, importable as a library.
Numerical routines: optimization, integration, sparse matrices, statistics.
Arbitrary-precision floating point and interval arithmetic.
Z3 SMT solver: integers, reals, bit-vectors, arrays, and quantifier-free proofs of unsatisfiability.
PySAT: CaDiCaL, Glucose, MiniSat and cardinality encodings for SAT problems.
OR-Tools: CP-SAT constraint programming, MIP, routing, and flows.
Convex optimization modelling: LP, QP, SOCP, SDP.
Graphs and graph algorithms: paths, flows, matchings, coloring, isomorphism.
nauty bindings: canonical labelling and automorphism groups of graphs.
